msg: I'm not sure that there is a set definite choice between the gnomes, I experimented with not only the colours, but the left/right positioning of the gnomes and the tall and short hats and found no evidence of a definite pattern.However, I did seem to feel that I recieved more points for the yellow, green and purple gnomes. Whether this was because I happened to pick them on 5x rounds where it therefore felt I recieved more points for those (superficially as they were still 'worth' around 1-5 points) or if there is a true correalation between those colours and the points.I found that the orange and red gnomes seemed to be most often the worst points, often coming up with 0, but again, this was not always the case so may not be causational.In terms of the right or left positioning, I tried selected left a few times in a row, the right and also tried alternating LRLRLR, none of these provided any obvious patterns. I do not think there is a difference between the two.For the hats, I did feel that the short hats tended to be between 3-7 points, which are good for 5x but again, there were some anomalies that may mean this was purely chance.Good luck!
